introduction: Utah Medicaid applications use myCase. An eligibility worker assesses the applicable coverage category and requested verification.
description: Utah Medicaid applications use myCase. An eligibility worker assesses the applicable coverage category and requested verification.

sections.who: Multiple pathways have different income and other conditions. Ask eligibility which pathway applies to each person rather than relying on one household-wide answer.
sections.get: Medical coverage under the approved Medicaid category.
sections.docs:
• Identity and household information.
  • Income and requested resource records.
  • Category-related evidence requested by the worker.
sections.apply:
1. Apply through myCase

    Use Utah Medicaid’s online application link.

  2. Return verification

    Provide requested records and explain any missing items.

  3. Read the decision

    Review coverage and enrollment instructions.
sections.after: Keep contact information current and respond to review notices so the worker can assess continued eligibility.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Utah Medicaid application, Eligibility pathways. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: No. Utah publishes a Medical Programs Summary with category-specific conditions.
The state directs these questions to a Medicaid Eligibility Worker.
The resident application link is myCase; PRISM resources mainly serve provider functions.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
